references.text: The slaughter of the sacrificial animal and the sprinkling of blood around the altar is the same procedure described for the burnt offering
The same ritual of sprinkling blood around the altar is performed with the peace offering
Moses also splashes blood on the altar at the consecration of Aaron and his sons
Parallel instruction in Exodus regarding the sprinkling of blood around the altar during priestly consecration
Aaron's sons hand him the blood, and he splashes it around the altar—the same practice that Moses performed
The Letter to the Hebrews refers to how Moses sprinkled blood on the tabernacle and its utensils, emphasizing that almost everything is cleansed with blood
